description: The file 'obfuscation.h' defines functions for obfuscating and unobfuscating data buffers using a passphrase. It includes function declarations for 'obfuscate' and 'unobfuscate', along with relevant includes and header guards, and contains licensing and copyright information.

methods.name: obfuscate
methods.description: Encrypts or obfuscates input data into a buffer using a passphrase, returning the obfuscated data and its length.

methods.name: unobfuscate
methods.description: De-obfuscates or decrypts data from a buffer back into its original form using the same passphrase.
